messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: service=redwood-serving-az3 severity=critical — High CPU and request queue growth observed in region az3 (us-west-az3). Autopager triggered: page sent to rotation 'sre-oncall'.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert 17-2034 - acknowledged? (auto-note) :rotating_light:

Jamie O'Connor: Acked. I'm on it. Logging in to dashboard now. Anyone already seeing customer-facing 5xxs?

Liam Chen: seeing 502 spike from model shard pool in az3. Client errors ~4.7% over last 2m, latency p50->p95 jumped from 70ms->1.2s. Queue depth for serving-worker group 'gpr-az3-s' is up.

Sophia Park: infra metrics show host CPU 95% on multiple nodes, and kernel'd OOMs starting on a subset of pods. NVMe IO saturation on iops-optimized nodes. Appears gradual buildup after a model eviction scheduled job.

Maya R.: Support: we have 8 customer reports referencing “slow responses” and 3 reports of timeout on hosted API keys in eu-west->us-west routing. No SSO or billing impact.

Liam Chen: Starting quick mitigation: divert traffic from az3 to az1/az2 via routing control plane. Command:
```
infractl route divert --from-region us-west-az3 --to-region us-west-az2 --percent 60 --reason "cpu-pressure-az3"
```
Will watch error % and tail logs.

ops-automation: Running diversion playbook step 1 -> routing change submitted, estimated propagation 45s.

Jamie O'Connor: Good. Also spinning up temporary burst capacity. Sophia can you bump autoscaler for model pool 'gpr-az3-s' by +4 nodes?

Sophia Park: Doing that now:
```
kubectl -n serving scale deploy gpr-az3-s --replicas=8
# infra autoscale trigger: infractl instances add --pool gpr-az3-s --count 4
```
Initiated, pending instance boot.

Liam Chen: Noted that prefix-KV cache rehydrates are heavy; if we bring new nodes they'll suffer thundering herd. Enabling prefix cache warmup (soft) on rollout to avoid immediate eviction.

ops-automation: Diversion completed: now sending ~62% of new requests to us-west-az2. Health checks passing in az2. Observability: client error rate in az3 trending down but still noisy.

Noah Patel: Product: Are paid customers impacted? Maya says a few timeouts — need hold message for status page. I can draft an update.

Maya R.: Please say: "Partial degraded responses in us-west-az3; routing divert in progress; mitigation underway. No data loss." I'll post to status.

Jamie O'Connor: PagerDuty: escalating to incident lead due to potential failover activation if node come back flaky. PD note: Incident annotated 'prefailover-traffic-divert'.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident escalated to Incident Lead (oncall@redwood). Additional responders paged.

Liam Chen: One of the root nodes shows disk errors and multiple pod restarts tied to eviction loop. I'm isolating it and pinning a fallback model variant (v1-compact) for traffic to reduce memory use:
```
routingctl set-variant --model textgen-003 --variant v1-compact --region us-west-az3 --percent 80
```

Sophia Park: New nodes are registering. Container runtime logs show crate-level GC thrash — we've increased JVM/heap flags on the model server and configured liveness probe grace.

Jamie O'Connor: Ops check: any customer with sustained errors we need to call? Maya, coordinate support callbacks for top-tier contracts.

Maya R.: On it. Notifying 2 enterprise accounts who reported issues; offering timeline and workaround (force routing to nearest region).

ops-automation: Autoscaler added 4 instances; took ~2m to be healthy. Traffic diverted, error rate p95 back to acceptable thresholds. Observability shows request latency stabilizing.

Jamie O'Connor: Ok team. Marking this as mitigated. Keep the channel open for 30m for flapping.

Liam Chen: I'll continue to monitor and collect logs for post-incident. Will open a postmortem ticket and tag infra/serving. Suspect scheduled eviction and cache rehydrate pattern caused the cascade.

Noah Patel: Thx. I'll coordinate customer comms and PR. Suggest postmortem include mitigation playbook updates: auto-warm caches, lower eviction concurrency, and throttled rehydrate.

Maya R.: Posted status update: "Partial degradation in us-west-az3; majority traffic diverted; mitigation in progress. No data loss. Updates every 30m."

Jamie O'Connor: Locking channel to incident followups only. When we have timeline for root cause and RCA owners, add to incident board.

incident-bot: Incident Mitigated: incident=INC-2026-0420 severity=high -> mitigated by routing diversion + autoscale. Postmortem ticket created: PM-4678.

Jamie O'Connor: Closing own ack. Will run a short blameless postmortem sync at 16:00 UTC. Thanks all.
